## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong Financials and Industrials performance plus broad sector participation; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Financials lead: C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +10.39%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -4.46% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION, CVX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +4.72%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary mixed with clear weakness: NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -13.00%) BELOW TREND. Communication has dispersion: TMUS (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -9.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +11.43% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +10.51% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -2.73%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -17.03%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -6.95% | 1M: +5.02%) CORRECTION, TMUS (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -9.94%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +4.72%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select cyclicals and energy names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +11.43% | 1M: -4.40%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -0.74%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +10.51% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -2.73%) RECOVERY. Note: Major divergence — several megacap techs show 1W up / 1M down (RECOVERY), so treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +10.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.04% | 1M: -3.10%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +9.35% | 1M: -0.23%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +9.00% | 1M: -13.18%) RECOVERY — tech strength present but concentrated in RECOVERY patterns for several megacaps.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Clear strength: C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND — Financials leading the advance and supporting the RISK-ON call.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Health showing selective strength: PFE (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.22% | 1M: +0.56%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.56% | 1M: -5.72%) RECOVERY — defensive names steady while biotech/drug news is driving idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Industrials exposure given ABOVE TREND leadership — JPM (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND, CAT/C (CAT: 1W: +3.72% | 1M: +2.15% ABOVE TREND; C: 1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72% ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to Energy names showing CORRECTION (XOM (1W: -4.46% | 1M: +8.36%) CORRECTION) and select Consumer Discretionary laggards like NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND; monitor tech RECOVERYs as tactical opportunities.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +10.39%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -14.29% | 1M: -24.11%) BELOW TREND, PSX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +6.54%) CORRECTION — watch for continuation or failure of recent reversals.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +5.20%), Industrials (1W: +3.56%) — monitor earnings/capital flows. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -4.16%) — watch for further profit-taking or mean reversion into strong 1M performance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch tech RECOVERY breakouts versus fails: NVDA (watch for sustained move above recent 1W highs to confirm trend), AAPL (watch support at recent 1W low for RECOVERY to hold), JPM (watch breakout above recent 1M highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation), XOM (watch failure below 1M support as signal to re-evaluate CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +5.56% | 1M: -5.72%) RECOVERY — VERY BULLISH news on oral obesity pill approval aligns with price lift, confirming catalyst-driven accumulation. UNH (+60): UNH (1W: +8.62% | 1M: -1.81%) RECOVERY — Medicare Advantage payment tailwind with price confirming the bullish read.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PSX (-65): PSX (1W: -5.82% | 1M: +6.54%) CORRECTION — mark-to-market and collateral headlines match the price pullback, confirming downside risk. TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -13.00%) BELOW TREND — negative analyst noise on top of weak trend is confirming. WMT (-55): WMT (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +3.03%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from price, watch for distribution vs. buy-the-news reactions.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Financials and Industrials showing relative strength — C (1W: +9.29% | 1M: +7.72%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.65%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +17.74% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND also notable. Key risk: major divergence among megacap techs (multiple RECOVERYs) — watch for trend breaks and monitor LLY/PSX sentiment-confirmed catalysts.
